name: lap-workspace
description: lap and kb: the TypeScript packages under packages/ are npm workspaces; the C tools under cli/ build with make.

scripts.build: npm run build:cli && npm run build:packages
scripts.test: npm run test:cli && npm run test:packages
scripts.test:cli: make -C cli/lap-cli test && make -C cli/kb-cli test
scripts.clean: make -C cli/lap-cli clean && make -C cli/kb-cli clean
